capabilities: link to folders using wiki links with a trailing slash
list notes linking to a folder in a backlinks panel
insert folder links into note bodies or properties
update folder links automatically when folders are renamed or moved
configure folder-link click behavior and link format
extras: The README says the plugin is pending review in the community plugin browser and includes manual installation steps; releases carry a build provenance attestation.
intentEvidence: the folder backlinks that core Obsidian doesn't have
problem: Obsidian backlinks only work for notes; folders cannot be linked or tracked with backlinks, and folder links would otherwise be treated as unresolved.
summary: Plugin that adds wiki links to folders and a sidebar panel listing which notes link to each folder, like backlinks for files.
